Why Sialkot Is Built for Small Batches

Most offshore hubs are volume machines — Bangladesh and Vietnam lines open at 1,000+ pieces because that is what they were built for. Sialkot's industry grew up on sports goods: short runs, constant design changes, heavy decoration. Small-batch culture is native here, not an exception a salesperson grants you.

Add local cotton and local knitting/dyeing mills, and small runs of tees, fleece and jerseys avoid the imported-fabric premium that makes Chinese and Vietnamese small batches expensive. That is why we can publish 50-piece prices that others quote only at 300.

We make hoodies, heavyweight tees, streetwear, sportswear and team kits, gym wear and full private label programs — ISO 9001 certified, amfori BSCI audited, DDP delivery to 30+ countries.

Small-Batch Questions

What counts as small batch clothing manufacturing?

Production runs between roughly 20 and 500 pieces per style — large enough for real cut-and-sew manufacturing with your own fabrics, fits and labels, small enough to test a design without warehouse-scale inventory risk. Below 20 pieces, print-on-demand decorating pre-made blanks is usually the better tool.

What is the smallest batch FABRIOZA will produce?

20 pieces — our trial-order tier, produced on the same lines with the same 4-stage QC as bulk, with the trial cost credited toward your first bulk order. Standard small-batch production starts at 50 pieces per style.

How much does small batch production cost per piece?

Published examples at the 50-piece tier: heavyweight tees $5.50, premium 280–350 GSM hoodies $12.00, sublimated jerseys $14.00, polos $9.00 — falling 10–40% at 100/250/500/1,000+ pieces. The full per-product table with decoration add-ons is public on our pricing page.

Why is Sialkot good for small batch production?

Sialkot's industry grew up on sports goods — short runs, frequent design changes, heavy decoration — so small-batch culture is native here, unlike volume-built hubs in Bangladesh or Vietnam where lines only open for 1,000+ pieces. Local cotton and local mills also remove the imported-fabric premium on knits and fleece.

Do small batches get the same quality as bulk orders?

Yes — every run at FABRIOZA, from a 20-piece trial upward, goes through the same 4-stage QC: fabric inspection, in-line stitching checks, finished-garment measurement audit, and pre-shipment inspection with photo documentation.
